notes.title: Update 17/09/2025
notes.content:
ADDED
- more weather presets

- new items:

  - added light sticks

  - hand grenade

  - throwing a mine or canister into a campfire will cause an explosion that kills everyone in range

  - throwing a mine into the train furnace will also cause an explosion that kills everyone

- added warning "session full" for full sessions

- server authorization now via Steam

- more quests

- notification system that warns about low fuel, nuclear strike, etc.

- leaderboard: top 4 survivors now displayed in the main menu

- two new snowy forest levels

- forester’s house on one of the locations

- radio voice hints with localized subtitles

- creepy monster models in the forest for atmosphere

- more crafting recipes

- rebind button for voice chat
CHANGED
- reworked quest system: 1 quest per level, quests unlock crafting recipes

- campfires must now be lit by interaction

- campfires now heal up to 75% health if you stand near them

- reduced max players per session from 10 to 4 (intended design + host couldn’t handle >4 players properly)

- screen shake now depends on distance to big monsters

- campfires now deal damage if standing too close

- big refactor & optimization of network synchronization

- more detailed text tutorial on the train board

- levels now load randomly from 5

- balanced crafting recipe ingredients

- reduced broken glass effect

- rebalanced item spawn in bunker
FIXED
- bug where a player leaving game broke the workbench

- bug where items selected for extraction differed between client and server

- bug where quests didn’t complete on clients

- session search by name in session menu

- bug where items stayed in chests after reload

- bug where players froze and lost input after opening settings menu and leaving location

- bug where broken screen effect didn’t reset after respawn

- bug where different players saw different items in the red puzzle room

- bug where crowbar broke inventory, blocking item switching

- bug where players fell through bunker floor on level 2

- duplicate animation playback

- bugs with visual hints highlighting items in bunker

- bug where players had different stats shown

- bug where host couldn’t hear clients in dead chat

- bug where players froze between extractions inside train safe zone

- many compilation errors causing game crashes

- some localization issues

KNOWN BUGS

- sometimes 1st-person camera shifts, interaction center misaligned

- full freeze once every 1–2 hours (10–20% chance)

- can’t interact with items at low FPS

- leaving bunker with 2 players at once sometimes fails to teleport one

- player sounds missing on some levels


Reminder: many bugs appear due to weak host hardware or bad connections, where clients lose packets or wait 3–4s for updates, missing game state changes.
We’ll keep optimizing the game & netcode so it can be played on weaker devices and slower internet.

Thank you all for your support, we are moving steadily towards release.  

We remind you that we are just three enthusiasts developing the game in our free time, aiming to make gamedev our profession and become independent.  

So please wishlist the game, share it with friends and streamers.  
Have a great game!!!

notes.title: Changelog - 13.08.2025

notes.title: Changelog - June and July

New monsters and variants; added to levels (incl. Level 03); humanoid navmeshes updated.

Option to randomly spawn enemies outside levels.

Mine: now interactable; warnings added, auto-despawn, strings; model fixed and hand position corrected.

🧭 | UI/UX & Service
Game version shown in the lobby list.

Tips: spawn via middle mouse button; increased tip spawn distance.

Improved "Loot Scanner."

"Kick from server" button for the host.
[hr][/hr]
CHANGED

 ⚖️ | Balance & Behavior
Monsters’ health ×3; faster street monsters; faster dog; adjusted spawn chances.

Kick now damages monsters (10 damage).

Stamina increased (+30%); jumping no longer consumes stamina.

Starting fuel set to 20.

Interactions are faster; smaller interaction circle.

Sledgehammer/crowbar: longer reach, better enemy hit detection.

Shotgun: fire chance, possible random misfire, cooldown.
💡 | Lighting & Flashlight
Flashlight no longer “infinite”; brightness depends on batteries.
🎧 | Audio
Improved nuclear explosion effects (visuals and feedback); reduced bunker reverb.

Removed voice compression; lowered player audio-source volume; reduced player voice gain.

Adjusted voice detection threshold.
📦 | Loot & Economy
More loot in crates; fuel added to random spawn.

Workbench: shows required items for spawning.


[hr][/hr]

FIXED

 🌐 | Network & Stability
Reworked session reconnection; fixed network exceptions/NREs.

Level-data sync between host and client.

Rare crashes (nullref/exception) across systems.
🛠️ | Gameplay & Animation
Teleport at dungeon exits; stuck/collision cases; leaving the train at the workbench.

Fixed walk/run/jump (animation lag), stair landing, spectator mode (L/R switch), F1 gesture direction, death delay.

Nuclear bomb: correct detonation, including when one player survives.

Crowbar no longer damages the player.
🔫 | Weapons & Items
Shotgun: aiming/targeting, explosion effects, damage; kick cooldown and its physics/animations/UI.

Mine: models, hand position, interaction, warnings, despawn; loot-scanner fixes for mines.

Crates/boxes and contents corrected.

Artifacts: proper effect deactivation when dropped, scaling, and item removal.
🗣️ | Audio & Voice
Voice-chat and host/client sync fixes; correct volume levels.

TrainHub scene updated for new audio settings.
🎯 | UI/UX & Visuals
Various NREs and minor visual issues fixed.

notes.title: Forgive us!
notes.content:
Unfortunately, we received a lot of feedback regarding the visual presentation of our Steam page, so we decided to bring back my rough in-game renderer. In the future, I’ll try to find an artist and ask them to create a proper one for us.

Many  players also complained that stamina runs out too quickly, so we’ve increased its regeneration rate. Additionally, a lot of players mentioned that our UI looks too similar to Lethal Company, so we’ve started creating our own retro-style version (for now, we've only changed the HP bar, but we’ll redesign the entire in-game HUD later).

We also want to apologize for the appearance of the Google Form survey. It was originally intended for a closed group of beta testers who were playing before the game became popular. I have no idea how it ended up in the demo version. I'm sorry we didn't manage to disable it in time when a large number of players started joining. But it's disabled now!

At the same time, we received a lot of positive feedback and many great ideas from you, which we’ve taken into account and will implement in future development.

And just a reminder — you can influence the game's development by sending us your feedback and ideas through the Discord form.

Thank you all for sharing the game with your friends. We’ll make it even better thanks to you!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 04/04/2025 (Added Hong Kong Region)
notes.content:
🛠️ Patch Notes
✨ Added
• Hong Kong Region
• A chemistry bottle that weakens players inside bunkers.
• Player eye movement, head turning, and gaze tracking toward nearby players — just because it looks cool.
• An analytics data collection agreement prompt.
• New crafting materials: chip, rag, pills, microchips, and batteries. Crafting recipes now require more appropriate items:
 • Flashlights now need a battery, chip, and scrap (no more sticks!)
 • Speed upgrades require specific colored pills 💊
 • Inventory slot upgrades now require rags 🧻
• A new enemy: Angry Mushroom 🍄 — defeat it by jumping on its head!
• Random ambient sounds in bunkers to enhance the atmosphere 🎧

🔁 Changed
• Increased player head size — because why not.
• Guitar mechanics reworked — now plays pre-made melodies 🎸
• Enemy damage reduced across the board.
• Voice pitch changes when shrinking are now less extreme.
• The hamster 🐹 now dies in two hits instead of three.
• Voice activation is now disabled by default.

🐞 Fixed
• Fixed player stat bars scaling incorrectly after a raid.
• Fixed items getting stuck in the host's hands when dropped.
• Improved overall game balance.
• Reworked enemy behavior:
 • Fixed several AI bugs
 • Added more sound effects
 • Improved enemy animations

⚠️ Known Issues
• Bunker exit door sometimes doesn’t spawn for clients.
• If the last surviving player leaves, it breaks the session.
• Enlarged players can get stuck in unexpected places.
• Dropped player corpses can clip through the floor.
• Life monitor screen may show incorrect player lists for clients.
• Some items may become unlootable after a player's death.

🙏 Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: New Update 09.03.2025
notes.content:
ADDED

 Added a new level.
 Added radio and random activation for players in the bunker.
 Added particle spawn for guitar notes.

FIXED

 Fixed a bug where enemies did not switch to the next live players.
 Fixed FPS drops inside the bunker.
 Fixed a bug where stamina was consumed even when standing still.
 Fixed a bug where players could fly beyond the map boundaries when dropping items.
 Fixed a bug where items dropped by players could not be picked up.
 Fixed minor UI bugs.
 Fixed a bug with excessive white snow brightness in weather settings.

CHANGED

 Reduced enemy damage by three times; now it takes 3 hits to kill a player.
 Increased interaction speed with workbenches and loot.
 Improved aiming for crowbar strikes.
 Removed private sessions, as they confused players and prevented them from seeing each other when creating private sessions.


We’ve received a lot of feedback from you about enemies killing you too quickly and instantly, so we’ve reduced their damage by three times. Additionally, you won’t encounter enemies on the first level, and the first two raids will always take place during the day. We are actively reviewing your feedback and planning how we will improve the game in the future based on your suggestions. Thank you for your support! Join our Discord and become a tester.

notes.title: Update based on community feedback
notes.content:
Demo Update Announcement 🎮✨

We've listened to your feedback and made some exciting improvements in the current demo version to make your gameplay more comfortable! 😊


 Bug Fix: Fixed an annoying bug where tossing scrap at your feet would launch it into textures or even off the map! 🐞🚀
 Audio Tweaks: Lowered the volume for item pickup/drop sounds, open-area weather ambience, and monster encounter alerts, while boosting player voice chat levels for clearer communication. 🔊🎧
 Enemy Behavior: Made an effort to fix the enemy behavior issue where they would freeze in place after the host’s death. 🤖❌
 Inventory Slots: Increased the starting slots to 4 (and in the future, we’ll add special slots for the Crowbar and flashlight). 📦🔦
 Session Visibility: Try to resolved the issue where players couldn’t see their friends’ sessions. 👀🤝
 Strike Radius Adjustment: Reduced the strike radius of the Crowbar for better attack aiming. 🎯✂️
 New Trailer & Stream: Dropped a brand new trailer and kicked off a live stream—check it out now! 🎬📺


Known Bugs 🐛🔍

 Enemy Freeze: The hamster can still sometimes freeze in place after killing a player. 🐹❄️
 Collider Glitch: Dropping two-handed heavy items at your feet in the bunker might push you through wall colliders, causing you to fall into the train area. 🚧🚂
 Password Issue: Text-based session passwords don’t work currently—only numeric passwords are supported. 🔠❌
 Exit Door Spawn: Rare instances of exit doors not spawning correctly in the dungeon for clients. 🚪🔄
 Spectator Audio: Players in spectator mode are difficult to hear. 👥🔇
  Ghost Voices: Dead players can still speak from their death location. 👻🗣️
 Key Responsiveness: The 1-2-3-4 keys may respond poorly during gameplay. ⌨️🐢


Please add the game to your wishlist, leave your reviews on Steam, and share your ideas for improvements – because we're building this game just for YOU!!! 💖🙏

Thank you all for your incredible support, positive feedback, and active bug hunting. We hope to create a unique and, most importantly, fun gaming experience for you and your friends! 🌟🎉
